requirement.title: Detect Claude Code instances via tmux
requirement.description: Identify Claude Code agent panes by matching tmux pane_current_command against the version pattern.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a tmux environment with panes running various commands (zsh, node, 2.1.89), when TmuxPoller runs list-panes, then only panes where pane_current_command matches /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/ are identified as agents.
Given a pane running "node" or "zsh", when TmuxPoller processes it, then the pane is excluded from the agent list.
Given gmux itself is running inside tmux, when TmuxPoller runs list-panes, then gmux auto-excludes its own pane by PID matching.

requirement.title: Poll tmux at regular intervals
requirement.description: TmuxPoller queries tmux every 3 seconds for pane state using tmux list-panes -a -F with fields: session_name, window_index, pane_index, pane_current_command, pane_current_path, pane_tty, pane_pid.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given gmux is running and tmux is available, when 3 seconds elapse since the last poll, then TmuxPoller executes list-panes and updates SessionStore.
Given a new agent pane appears between polls, when the next poll runs, then the new pane is added to SessionStore and a "new agent found" event is emitted.
Given an agent pane disappears between polls, when the next poll runs, then the pane is marked as terminated and a "session ended" event is emitted.

requirement.title: Heuristic status detection from pane content
requirement.description: When no socket override exists for a pane, TmuxPoller captures pane content via tmux capture-pane and classifies status using regex heuristics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given captured pane content contains "-- INSERT --", when status heuristic runs, then status is classified as "idle".
Given captured pane content contains "Whisking" or "thinking", when status heuristic runs, then status is classified as "active".
Given captured pane content contains "[Y/n]" or "proceed?", when status heuristic runs, then status is classified as "needs_attention".
Given captured pane content matches no known pattern, when status heuristic runs, then status is classified as "unknown" and displayed as "?".

requirement.title: Socket events override heuristics
requirement.description: Status pushed via /tmp/gmux.sock takes priority over heuristic classification. Socket status is retained until the next socket event or until the pane disappears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a socket event sets pane arcforge:1.1 status to "idle", when TmuxPoller's heuristic would classify it as "active", then SessionStore reports status as "idle" (socket wins).
Given a socket status override exists for a pane, when a new socket event arrives for the same pane, then the override is updated to the new status.
Given a socket status override exists for a pane, when that pane disappears from tmux, then the override is cleared.

requirement.title: Extract detail metadata from pane content
requirement.description: For the selected session, parse the last assistant text block from captured pane content (content between the last thinking indicator and the input prompt) to show as the "last output snippet" in the detail panel.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a captured pane with visible Claude output, when detail extraction runs, then the last assistant text block is extracted and truncated to fit the detail panel.
Given a captured pane with no parseable assistant block, when detail extraction runs, then the detail panel shows "No recent output" instead of raw terminal noise.
